text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Almond Eye and the others were having a dance battle,
I popped over to see how it was going...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We rarely get the chance to compete in dance,
so this is really exciting!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm really happy to be with you and the others too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the invite.
Please go easy on me, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right back at you! ...Though I must say,
I'm looking forward to the three of you showing your true "Love" too♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then... we'll decide the theme by drawing lots.
After that, you'll have one hour to practice before presenting.
—The theme is:

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It's... “Whoever makes the other laugh wins: Funny Dance”!

text_block_list.name: Ai & Lala
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, "Make 'Em Laugh, Funny Dance"!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Th-This looks—quite difficult, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
But still, wouldn't we have the advantage?
...I mean, can you even imagine our seniors doing a weird dance?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Besides, stuff like that makes people embarrassed if they're not used to it, right?
On that front, you and me...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to it thanks to Loves-chan's stream projects.
...Which means there's a chance of victory.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm—a chance at victory, huh?
Whatcha gonna do, Ai-san?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I have a good idea.
Will the two of you come with me?"
One hour later—

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-maaah, maaah, maaah, maaahâª
Maaah, maaah, maaah, maaahâª

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-maaah, maaah, maaah, maaahâª
Maaah, maaah, maaah, maaahâª
choice_data_list: Hahaha, I see, so it's the Tracen Ondo!
Fufufu, I see, the Tracen Ondo, right!

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but laugh at the delightful choreography.
It certainly leaves quite an impact...!
choice_data_list: (I wonder what Ai and the others are going to do about this...?)

text_block_list.text: What funny dance could possibly top this—

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!?

A vivid folding fan waving without hesitation.
And yet, not a single facial muscle twitching.
—Almond Eye and the others were completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Ufufufu!
Ufufufufufu...! No way――could it be?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... W-Why do you have such a straight face...!
You're usually so cool, and yet—!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I don't need pride to win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll go for the win with everything I have. ...That's all there is to it!
choice_data_list: Pfft... No, you look so cool, but—!
Pfft... No, you look so cool, but—!

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text: I concede...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's a unanimous decision: victory goes to our upperclassmen.
...I also learned quite a lot from this!
choice_data_list: I want even more people to see this!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? ...Y-You think so?
I feel like I only managed it because of the situation.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Indeed, under different circumstances, the exact same thing might not make you laugh.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! This dance is special just for today!
...Buuut it was so fun, I wanna do it again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Captivating not just with choreography—but with facial expressions too.
...I learned a great deal from that."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Hearing you say that... makes it all worth it.
